frederick-residents-data-center-agreemen.headline: Frederick Residents - Data Center Agreement Impact Perspectives
frederick-residents-data-center-agreemen.description:
Journalist looking for perspectives on data center agreement\
\
Hi all! I'm a journalist with American University currently working on a story about the proposed data center agreement in Frederick. Under this agreement, the county would receive funding from developers to (among other things) renovate an elementary school, create an agricultural reserve, workforce development programs and solar projects.\
\
While these projects may provide benefits to residents, people across the country have many concerns about how data centers will impact their communities environmentally, socially and economically.\
\
 \
I'm hoping to gather as many perspectives from Frederick residents as possible, and would love to hear anyone's thoughts on the subject. Feel free to comment here or DM me to share your thoughts or with any questions. Thanks!

london-tech-telecoms-and-banking-veteran.headline: London Tech, Telecoms \u0026 Banking Veterans - Navigating Change
london-tech-telecoms-and-banking-veteran.description:
I've spent 20 years in tech, telecoms and banking. Long enough to see a lot of 'transformations' come and go. \
\
Here's the thing nobody really talks about: with any new technology rollout, about 70% of it comes down to lessons from the past and the experience of people on the ground. It's the other 30%, the unknown, that we're actually navigating. \
\
The systems, the strategy, the frameworks, they matter, but I've watched them work brilliantly for one team and quietly wreck another, and the difference usually isn't the technology. \
\
So back in April I started my venture called ValyoLab*, and I'm finally ready to talk about the first thing to come out of it: The Experience Room™. \
It's simple. I sit down with people and record real conversations about their experience, lessons at work, managing change, tech leaps, whatever's actually true for them, and then we publish it so others can hear it too. \
\
The studio is in Canary Wharf and I'm lining up the conversations with lovely people who talk about what change actually feels like from the inside. \
\
If you've got a story about navigating change and you'd like to sit down with me and talk about it, I'd love to hear from you. \
\
Fingers crossed for more updates.\
\
#TheExperienceRoom #ValyoLab #HumanExperience #TechTransformation\
*pronounced as 'ValueLab'

edtech-product-managers-lms-audit-does-p.headline: EdTech Product Managers - LMS Audit - Does Product Manage Learning
edtech-product-managers-lms-audit-does-p.description:
The most successful education technology of the last twenty-five years has never taught anyone anything.\
It enrols students, files their PDFs, records attendance and posts grades. We call it a learning management system. Learning is the one thing it does not manage.\
For twenty-five articles I have prosecuted the university — the Factory of Facts, its assembly line of credits and semesters. This week I turn to the factory's suppliers, and open a new arc of ten: The EdTech Audit.\
The first finding is uncomfortable. An industry that raised billions promising to disrupt the factory went into business selling it faster conveyor belts.\
The evidence is in the logs. A full semester of LMS usage data at one large university: Announcements in 82% of courses. Grades in 71%. The discussion board — the one tool built for students to think in front of each other — in 21%.\
A noticeboard, a filing cabinet, and a ledger. The pedagogy in the basement.\
Why? Follow the invoice. The learner has never signed the cheque for an LMS. The registrar does. And a product serves whoever pays for it, with a fidelity no mission statement can override. I call it The Vendor Trap.\
Three questions I would ask of every EdTech product before a rupee moves: Does it touch the learning or the ledger? Whose week actually improves? What does it measure?\
The factory is closing. Its best supplier has not noticed.\
Full piece below — and I would genuinely like to hear from those of you inside EdTech: which of your products would pass all three questions? 👇#ReimagineEducation #EdTech #HigherEducation #LMS #EdTechAudit #AcademicLeadership #DigitalTransformation #LearningDesign #UniversityStrategy #NEP2020 #FutureOfEducation #EdTechIndia
